name: hcapp_getMyPhotoAssetIds
description: The camera-roll asset ids of photos the CALLER has already uploaded, optionally narrowed to one kennel or one run. Lets the camera-roll sweep say '14 eligible, 6 already added' and stop offering a photo that is already on the run, with one call for a whole kennel.

rowsets.name: MyPhotoAssetIds
rowsets.description: One row per uploaded photo of the caller's that carries a camera-roll asset id. Never includes anybody else's photos: an asset id is a handle into a private photo library.

columns.name: eventId
columns.description: The run the photo belongs to.

columns.name: assetId
columns.description: The camera-roll identifier the photo was uploaded from.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
